intro: draw.io to PNG turns draw.io (diagrams.net) diagrams into PNG images to insert into a presentation, a Word document, a wiki, an email or a web page. Each diagram tab becomes an image; if there are several, you download them together in a ZIP.

The diagram is drawn with the official draw.io viewer, the same engine as the application, so it looks the same as in the editor. You choose the scale: 1× for actual size, 2× to look sharp on high-resolution screens or 3× if you will print it. The image size fits what is drawn, with a small margin.

You can keep a white background or make it transparent, useful for placing the diagram over a coloured background in a presentation or website. Text, colours, arrows and embedded images are kept; those the diagram loads from the internet are not, because the browser that draws it has no network access.
We accept .drawio and .dio files of up to 20 MB. Images are capped at 8000 pixels per side: a huge diagram at 3× is reduced just enough to stay within that size.
steps: Choose the scale and whether you want a transparent background.
Download the PNG or the ZIP with every page.

faq.a: 2× is best for screens and documents. For large prints, 3×. 1× gives the diagram's exact size in the editor.
For now, PNG or PDF. The PDF keeps the diagram as vectors and can be converted afterwards with PDF to SVG.

faq.q: Why is an icon missing from my diagram?
faq.a: If the icon was loaded from a web address, it is not included. Insert the image into the diagram and convert it again.
